'''''Scrophularia sambucifolia''''' is a species of flowering plant in the figwort family ([[Scrophulariaceae]]) native to the [[Iberian Peninsula]] and [[Northwest Africa]].

==Description==
[[File:Betony Scrophularia sambucifolia - Flickr - gailhampshire.jpg|thumb|left|Part of the inflorescence]]
''Scrophularia sambucifolia'' is a [[perennial]] [[rhizomatous]] [[Glabrous (botany)|glabrous]] herb with stems up to {{convert|1.90|m|ft|abbr=on}} tall with little or no ramification. [[Inflorescence]] is usually {{convert|15|-|50|cm|in|abbr=on}} long with 1 to 10 opposed flowers. [[Sepal|Flower crown]] is orange-reddish, orange-purple or greenish-yellow with orange spots, upper lip is reddish purple. [[Anther]]s are yellow, sometimes with bluish margins. [[Staminode]] is purple, sometimes greenish-purple.<ref name="iberica">{{cite web |title=Scrophularia sambucifolia |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/13_144_02_Scrophularia.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref>

==Distribution and habitat==
''Scrophularia sambucifolia'' is native to the southwest [[Iberian Peninsula]] (in central and southern [[Portugal]], mainly [[Médio Tejo]], [[Lezíria do Tejo]], [[Baixo Alentejo (intermunicipal community)|Baixo Alentejo]] and [[Algarve]],<ref name="flora-on">{{cite web |title=Scrophularia sambucifolia subsp. sambucifolia |url=https://flora-on.pt/#1scrophularia+sambucifolia |publisher=Flora-on |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref> southwest [[Spain]] and [[Gibraltar]]) and [[Northwest Africa]] (in [[Morocco]], [[Algeria]] and [[Tunisia]]) where it inhabits moist sites, usually close to the margins of water lines, preferably on deep soils of [[mud]] or [[limestone]] origin.<ref name="iberica" /><ref name="flora-on" />

==Subspecies==
There are two known subspecies:

*''S. sambucifolia'' subsp. ''sambucifolia'': Endemic to southwest [[Iberia]] and Morocco.<ref name="iberica" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Scrophularia sambucifolia subsp. sambucifolia |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/7L3XV |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref>
*''S. sambucifolia'' subsp. ''mellifera''<small>(Aiton)</small>: Endemic to southwest Spain, Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia.<ref name="iberica" /><ref>{{cite web |title=Scrophularia sambucifolia subsp. mellifera (Aiton) Maire |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/7KS9V |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref>
